label: RESHAPE THE THESIS
call: The council narrowly favours adding a quarter more to Microsoft, but only once the investor writes down a limit for how much of the portfolio one stock may be. Today it is 18% [F017].

why.point: Returns on capital near 30% [F009] in a business customers cannot easily leave.
The price asks for 14% growth a year for a decade [F013]; the edge is real but small, so the add should be too.
Cloud sales grew 38% [F006], and that is where the spending is going.

minority.quote: No single stock should decide your life.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Taleb would be proven right if Microsoft falls 37% again while it is a fifth of the portfolio.

premortem: The data center spending earns less than it costs and margins fall.
A fall like the 37% on record arrives while the position is at its largest.
The investor keeps adding on every dip until one stock decides the outcome.

kill_criteria.text: Capital spending stays high without better margins
The position grows past a fifth of the portfolio

conditions: A written limit for the size of any one stock

next_steps.action: Write down the size limit before adding.

cheapest_test: Write the size limit first; add only if it still allows it.
sizing_note: At 18% already, ask what a 37% fall in this one stock would do to you.
lean_pull_note: Doubling gained a little after the lean was shared; it still ranks last.
data_health: Prices, filings and rates ok; no analyst estimates, news or short interest.

amendments.amendment: Add only on a real fall.
amendments.reason: The council kept the add, with a size limit instead.
